data.name: Cahyani
data.gender_notes: Cahyani is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Javanese word 'Cahya', meaning 'graceful' or 'elegant'. The name Cahyani carries the meaning “Graceful, elegant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Indonesian. Parents who choose Cahyani usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, elegant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Cahyani is believed to bring blessings of beauty, grace, and love in the spiritual realm. It is also believed to represent the divine feminine energy and the nurturing qualities of a mother.
data.etymology: Cahyani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, elegant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cahyani total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
